title_en: Building Access Restrictions for the 2027 Law School Admissions
summary: Building 17 (the entire Law School building) will be closed to everyone except personnel involved in the Law School entrance examination from Friday, 6 November to Saturday, 7 November 2026. During this period, all others must not enter the building and must avoid making noise inside or outside it. This restriction applies to the 2027 admissions for the Law School professional master's program.
applies_to: Everyone who is not personnel involved in the Law School entrance examination (mandatory). The restriction covers the entire Law School Building 17 during the stated control period.

dates.what: Access restriction period for the entire Law School Building 17 (no entry except entrance examination personnel; avoid noise inside and outside the building)

conditions: During the restriction period, no one other than Law School entrance examination personnel may enter Building 17.
The restriction covers the entire Building 17, not only parts of it.
Everyone must avoid making noise both inside and outside Building 17 during the restriction period.
The notice does not state any exceptions for students or staff who are not examination personnel.
steps: Do not enter any part of Law School Building 17 from 6 to 7 November 2026 unless you are entrance examination personnel.
Make other arrangements in advance for any work, study or meetings you would normally hold in Building 17 on those days.
Keep noise to a minimum when you are near Building 17 during the restriction period.
translation:
Title: Notice of Building Access Restrictions for the 2027 Law School Admissions

We hereby announce the building access restrictions and requests for cooperation related to the 2027 admissions process for the Law School professional master's program, as set out below. We ask for your cooperation so that the admissions process can proceed smoothly.

Restriction period: Friday, 6 November 2026 to Saturday, 7 November 2026

Restricted area: The entire Law School Building 17

Requests for cooperation
A. During the restriction period, no one other than personnel involved in the Law School entrance examination may enter the restricted area.
B. Please refrain from making noise inside and outside the restricted area.
